objective: Bring Shaky's Payment to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley

description: Here, take this pouch and give it to Sea Wolf.  And tell him I meant to pay him back!  I swear!!
I just got a little drunk and lost my way, and...you know how things are.  He'll understand - you don't have to get rough!
progress: Here here, <name>. Did you get Shaky's payment?
completion: Heh heh, well done! And when you showed Shaky those giblets, how hard did he shake?
Hah! He's so easy to read, when I play cards with him I can't help but win!
Thanks for your help, <name>. Now it's your turn to get paid...
